jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Workflows (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Workflows (m/f/d), you'll build the agentic workflows that run our solution delivery behind the scenes. Every customer project produces requirements, designs, plans, and checks on the way from a customer's problem to a robot running on their factory floor. Your agents will work at each of these steps: reviewing requirements before they become commitments, checking and improving artifacts as the project moves, and catching risks while there's still time to act on them. You'll build the first agentic workflows, the reusable components and governance they run on, and much of how RobCo uses AI internally.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run agentic workflows across our delivery process - requirements review, automated checks and gates, early risk detection, and a knowledge base that makes everything we've learned from past projects available to agents and people - owning each from concept through production.

  • Build the way we build: reusable components, skills, and patterns for tool integrations, feedback loops, and identity, secret, and auth management. You know the agentic toolbox inside out and decide what we actually need and what we don't.

  • Own quality end to end: design and run evals, monitor agents in production, and manage observability, cost, guardrails, and security so teams can trust what the agents produce.

  • Design human-in-the-loop workflows that learn: people review and correct agent output at defined checkpoints, and those corrections flow back into better prompts, evals, and components, so the agents keep improving.

  • Embed with our delivery teams to understand how their work actually flows, identify where agents create the most leverage, and define together what good looks like.

  • Drive adoption and help shape how RobCo uses AI internally: deliver agents through the tools teams already use every day, establish best practices, and build paved paths so teams can eventually create their own agents.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Several years of software engineering experience and the seniority to take a problem from ambiguous idea to production system, with clean architecture, solid testing, and maintainable code.

  • Shipped LLM-powered or agentic systems that real users depend on, not just prototypes: tool calling, structured outputs, multi-step workflows. Deep, practical experience with the agentic stack — orchestration, tool use, MCP, memory, and retrieval — in production environments.

  • Strong context engineering and prompt engineering skills: you think carefully about what the model sees and in what structure, you treat prompts as versioned, tested engineering artifacts, and you have a rigorous way of judging whether the output is actually good.

  • Built knowledge bases and put RAG pipelines to work. You don't need to be a retrieval specialist; you need to make organizational knowledge reliably available to agents and people.

  • Thinks in terms of systems and user outcomes, not individual scripts and demos, and brings a component mindset: while building the first agent, you're already thinking about the second and the tenth.

  • Genuine enjoyment of working with non-engineering teams: understanding their process, speaking their language, and designing automation around how they actually work.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, plus fluency with SaaS APIs, webhooks, and the practical realities of integrating business systems.

  • Ownership of outcomes and a startup way of working: scope intentionally, build smart, ship fast, and prefer pragmatic solutions that ship over perfect ones that don't.

  • Fluent English (German is a plus).

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office in Munich whenever you with to visit, and the flexibility to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

jobs.title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
jobs.description:
The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access

Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.

The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.

We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.

Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.

What You Own

• Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment.

• Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing.

• Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.

• Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.

• Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.

• Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.

• Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.

What This Role Is Not

• It is not a traditional marketing leadership job.

• It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role.

• It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists.

• It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate;

This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.

Important:

  • This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract.

  • This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany.

Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you:

  • Highly competitive salary + Bonus

  • Fully remote work environments.

  • Self-managed time off.


Who We Want

• You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI

product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

• You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility.

• You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,

enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

• You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.

• You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.

• You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.

• You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

Strong Background Signals

• Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories.

• Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.

• Large-company titles alone are not compelling.

Anti-Profile

• Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."

• You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.

• You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.

• You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.

• You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.

• You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome

• 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.

• 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.

• 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

How Success Is Measured

• Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.

• Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,

retention and expansion.

• Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion.

• Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

Operating Model and Reporting

This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.

Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth

organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes

repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.

Security Expectations

You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially

technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,

deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection

defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.

Compensation Philosophy

We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator

than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and

demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value.

The Test

A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten

customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to

execute the work with minimal human headcount.

jobs.description:

At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

You'll accelerate your growth in our fast-paced environment, tackling daily challenges and learning from inspiring leaders and teammates. Be empowered to create impact for our future by shaping the most-loved package holiday experience for millions. As we pursue ambitious plans to expand across Europe, you'll be part of a fun-loving international community achieving great things together.

About the team:

The On Holiday Support team helps customers resolve issues that arise while they are away. This can include transfer problems, accommodation concerns, supplier issues, flight disruption and other unexpected situations that may affect a customer’s holiday.

Customers may contact us when they are tired, worried, frustrated or unsure what to do next. Our role is to listen, understand what has happened and take ownership of finding the most appropriate resolution.

You will be part of the UK On Holiday Support team and report to an On Holiday Support Team Leader. You will also work closely with colleagues in our offshore partner team and with suppliers and internal departments across loveholidays..

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. We welcome applications from candidates based in London and the surrounding areas. As this role requires some attendance at our London office, applications from candidates with a commute of more than 2 hours each way will not be considered.

You’ll support customers at moments when the service we provide can have a real impact on their holiday, taking ownership and responding with empathy, urgency and sound judgement.

Our teams are split across the UK and our offshore partner, so being comfortable working cross-culturally is important. A customer-first mindset and strong problem-solving skills are essential, particularly when handling more challenging cases and helping restore customers’ confidence in loveholidays.   • Make outbound calls when speaking directly with a customer or supplier is the quickest and most effective way to resolve an issue

  • Keep customers updated and set clear expectations throughout their case

  • Recognise risk and escalate safeguarding, wellbeing or major incident concerns through the correct process

  • Maintain clear, accurate and complete case notes

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues in the UK, our offshore partner and other loveholidays teams

  • Identify recurring customer or supplier issues and provide feedback so that the underlying cause can be addressed

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of relevant processes, policies, systems and travel-industry developments

  • Strong and demonstrable customer-service skills

  • A calm, empathetic and professional communication style

  • Confidence speaking with customers who may be upset, frustrated or under pressure

  • Strong ownership and a willingness to see issues through to resolution

  • Sound judgement and the confidence to make decisions within agreed guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail

  • Emotional resilience and the ability to work effectively with sensitive or challenging customer situations

  • A collaborative approach and confidence working with colleagues from different teams and cultures

Other than an amazing environment for you to grow, have impact and show the world your incredible skills, we offer the following benefits:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave

Tasks

  • Own the visual and interaction design language of the entire platform, and hold it together across a product that keeps growing
  • Turn product concepts into wireframes, then into build-ready design files with states, edge cases, responsive behaviour and interaction detail
  • Own our design system: the component library, tokens, and keeping it honest against what is actually implemented in the frontend
  • Design to WCAG 2.1 AA. Accessibility comes up more and more in DACH procurement, and we would rather build it in than retrofit it
  • Run design QA together with our QA team, so what ships matches what was designed
  • Run customer interviews and usability tests, in support of discovery and to validate your own concepts

Being clear about this up front, because it is the thing candidates most often get a surprise about.

  • Product discovery and concepts sit with our Head of Product. He runs that process and writes the specs, so you will not be starting from a blank page. But what we build and why is decided as a team, and talking to customers is something several of us do.
  • You own how it gets designed. Interaction, layout, visual language, the design system, and the quality of what actually ships. Within the problem, the solution is yours, and you are expected to push back when the proposed approach is the wrong one.
  • Design-led topics become yours to drive. Not on day one. But once you know the product and the industry, we would expect you to bring your own proposals for the things design should be leading, whether that is navigation, information architecture or a visual overhaul, and to take them through the concept phase yourself rather than waiting for a spec. That is what we are looking for at senior level rather than mid.

Requirements

  • Several years designing complex, logic-heavy B2B or SaaS products, including at least one you shaped visually over a longer period
  • Strong visual craft. Typography, hierarchy, spacing and information density in data-heavy interfaces, and the judgement to make a dense admin tool feel calm
  • Deep fluency in a modern design tool, including building and maintaining component libraries

  • Responsive and mobile design, including users who only ever access the platform on a phone
  • You can run interviews and usability tests yourself, and turn what you hear into design decisions
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • German good enough to run customer interviews in it
  • Experience designing within an established product, not only greenfield work
  • Experience with multi-tenant products where customers apply their own branding

Not part of this role

Brand, marketing and website design. This is a product role, full stop. If your portfolio is mainly campaigns, landing pages and visual identity, we are probably not a good match.

Benefits

  • Real ownership: you are the design function, and the product will visibly carry your decisions
  • Direct access to customers and to decision-makers, with no layers in between
  • We believe in the power of working remotely. It is your choice from where you work, anywhere within EU time zones
  • We support flexible working hours. It is your choice when you work
  • elearnio is built on the idea of life-long learning. We offer a budget for your development and training needs

Your application

Please send a portfolio. We are looking for two things: evidence of visual and interaction craft in a complex interface, and at least one case study that shows your reasoning from problem to shipped result. If you have worked on tying a growing product together, we especially want to see that.

Our Application Process

  1. One session with our product team, around 90 minutes. We get to know each other, you walk us through one project from your portfolio in depth, and we talk through how you would approach a real elearnio design problem. A discussion, not an exercise. Please pick one project to go deep on rather than a tour of several.
